story.title: You arrive at a small market on the mountain.
story.text: Fresh vegetables are displayed in baskets, and several sellers are speaking with customers.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Wow! There are so many vegetables here. I want to ask the price politely.

choices.text: Excuse me, how much is this bundle of vegetables?

feedback.reaction: Good start! 💰 The seller understands the question clearly.
Alex looks confused 😅 because the sentence sounds unnatural and unclear.
That sounds too direct 😬 and not polite for a market conversation.

story.title: You look at a price tag.
story.text: A basket of vegetables is priced at 100 baht. Alex hears another customer say, 'That is cheap.'

scenes.question: In this price context, what does 'cheap' mean?

choices.text: It costs little or has a low price.

feedback.reaction: Correct! 👍 Alex understands the price comment.

choices.text: It is located far away from the market.

feedback.reaction: Wrong meaning ❌ The word is about price here, not distance.

choices.text: It is much heavier than expected.

feedback.reaction: Not related 🤔 The sentence does not mention weight.

story.title: Alex wants a better price.
story.text: Alex thinks the price is slightly high but still wants to be respectful to the seller.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: This is a bit expensive. How can I ask for a lower price without being rude?

choices.text: Could you lower the price a little if I buy two bundles?

feedback.reaction: Nice bargaining 😎 The request is polite and gives a reason.

choices.text: You must make it free because I am a tourist.

feedback.reaction: That is not polite 😅 and gives an unfair demand.

choices.text: Give me 80 baht now, or I will blame your shop.

feedback.reaction: Alex looks embarrassed 😳 because the sentence sounds aggressive.

story.title: The seller offers a new price.
story.text: The seller smiles and offers a better price after Alex asks politely.

choices.text: That sounds fair. I'll take one, please.

feedback.reaction: That sounds unclear 😅 and would not complete the purchase.

choices.text: I will take two without paying.

feedback.reaction: Alex steps back 😬 because that would be dishonest.

story.title: Alex is happy with the purchase.
story.text: Alex bought vegetables politely and learned how to bargain without offending the seller.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: That was fun! I love this market.

choices.text: I'm glad you enjoyed it; the market is a good place to practice polite bargaining.

feedback.reaction: Alex smiles 😊 and feels more confident speaking with sellers.

choices.text: You should tell the seller everything is bad after buying it.

feedback.reaction: Alex looks confused 😕 because that would be rude and unnecessary.
That does not match the scene ❌ because Alex just bought vegetables.
